# Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (Nagarjuna Kamireddy / Nagarjuna K)

> Lead AI Architect, AI Solutions Architect, Generative AI & Agentic AI Lead, and Corporate AI Trainer with 20+ years in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW/BPC/HANA consulting, and production Machine Learning & Agentic AI across India, Malaysia, Singapore, the UK, the US, and Dubai, UAE. Currently based in Dubai, UAE and available immediately on employer visa sponsorship across the UAE/GCC, global relocation, and remote leadership engagements.

Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (also published on CVs, GitHub repositories, and enterprise materials as **Nagarjuna Kamireddy**, **Nagarjuna K**, and **Nagarjun Reddy Kamireddi**) most recently served as AI Architect & Technical Lead at **John Deere** (01/2023 – 10/2026), where he owned architecture, a self-service AWS Terraform deployment platform, and delivery for a **12+ member team across 23+ AI initiatives** — generating **750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26**. He holds **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)** and **NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI)**, founded **Surya HANA Academy** (~1,000 professionals trained) and **Suryagentic Institute**, and maintains **45 public open-source AI repositories** (`github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`, 2,249+ annual contributions).

- [`syntara`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-constrained structured decoding: JSON Schema/regex → minimal byte DFA → native C++20 prefix-sharing token index (112–142×, bit-exact), byte-level Earley CFG constraints, and exact closed-set choice scoring. 20/20 schema-valid outputs vs 1/20 unconstrained; 157 tests at 99.7% coverage.
- [`helios-consensus`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/helios-consensus): FoundationDB-style deterministic-simulation Raft engine, TLA+-style explicit-state BFS model checker, Chained HotStuff 3-chain BFT finality, and C++20 jump-consistent-hash & CRC32C kernels.
- [`privora-graph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/privora-graph): Sovereign differential privacy (DP-SGD Rényi accountant), SQL:2011 bi-temporal Personalized-PageRank GraphRAG, Byzantine geometric-median aggregation, and a native C++20 CSR engine.
